question: What powers arise from this practice regarding distant hearing and bonds?
premises: Knowledge of distant hearing is mentioned as an attainment
Paralysis of bonds is mentioned as another attainment
These are presented together as results
inference: The practice yields knowledge of distant hearing and the paralysis of bonds
uncertainties: pāśa-stobham may refer to arresting bonds or immobilizing fetters
plain_english: O beloved, one gains knowledge of distant hearing and likewise the power to paralyze bonds.
